# REVIEW-3 — Polish, docs & final verification

## Polish

* **Copy:** every status avoids certainty ("likely opened", "possibly auto-loaded", "no reply *detected*", "Open tracking is an estimate, never proof of reading"). Auto-loaded messages no longer say "Opened …" anywhere (C5).
* **Layout:** popup rows were restructured (recipient + status / subject + time / "via account" chip). The Gmail strip popover was widened so the preset chips fit on one line. Popup, options page and strip were checked in light and dark in headless Chrome.
* **Icons:** original icons generated by `scripts/gen-icons.mjs` (ink-blue rounded square, postmark ring, white + green double check). Sent-list marks are 16 px SVGs (grey/green/amber ✓✓, blue link). Nothing is borrowed from Mailsuite/Mailtrack.
* **Tooltips:** row marks show the relative and absolute time of the last open or click. The strip's status badge carries a long explanation in `title` and for screen readers.
* **a11y:** every injected control has an ARIA label or role (`aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` on the strip toggle, `role="dialog"` popover with Escape to close and initial focus, `role="tablist"` in the popup, `role="alert"`/`status` for messages), visible `:focus-visible` rings, and `prefers-reduced-motion` respected.

## Dead code removed

Unused constants (`PIXEL_PATH_PREFIX`, `LINK_PATH_PREFIX`, `ID_LENGTH`), `isValidAccount`, the unused `call()`/`BusFailure` bus helper, the `register()` base-URL override, and the unused `iconUrl` compose dependency.

## Bundle size (production build)

| Bundle | Size | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `content.ts-*.js` | ~1.04 MB (≈ 313 kB gzip) | ≈ 98% InboxSDK. Loaded only on mail.google.com from the local extension package. |
| `pageWorld.js` | 575 kB | InboxSDK page-world script, required for MV3 |
| shared zod/schema chunk | 59 kB | used by the service worker, popup and options |
| service worker | 19 kB | |
| popup / options | 8 kB / 11 kB (+ 11 kB Preact runtime) | |
| **Total `extension/dist`** | ≈ 1.8 MB | |

The content-script size is dominated by InboxSDK and accepted. It's local, not downloaded per page view.

## Fresh-clone test (2026-10-07), following the README exactly

```
git clone <repo> fresh && cd fresh
npm install                          # 0 vulnerabilities
npm run verify                       # typecheck + lint + format + tests (37 / 90 / 133) + both builds → exit 0
npm run dev:server                   # GET /healthz → {"ok":true}
npm run seed                         # 5 messages, 2 accounts, opens / auto-load / click / bot
npm run simulate                     # 7 UA profiles → status=opened opens=2 possiblyAutoLoaded=1
```

Then `extension/dist` from the clone was loaded unpacked into Chrome for Testing 155 (headless) and connected with the seed token via **Options → Connect with an existing token**. The popup listed all 5 seeded messages, including the simulated message as "Opened 2×", with "via account" chips. No console errors in the service worker, popup or options. ✅

The Docker path (`docker compose build`, then run, `/healthz`, pixel 43 bytes) was verified in E1.

## Not verifiable here (stated plainly)

There is no Gmail session in this environment, so the InboxSDK-driven Gmail surfaces (compose eye button, Sent-list marks, thread strip) have **not been exercised in live Gmail**. Their logic is covered by the mocked-adapter tests, and their failure modes by the break tests. The README's manual checklist is the next step.
